svg.aria-label: Estimated decode speed by model and machine
svg.text: Estimated decode speed, tokens per second
My arithmetic, not measurements: active params × 0.56 GB ÷ (bandwidth × 0.60). Before MTP or draft models.
Grey cells mean the weights do not fit in memory at Q4. Capacity decides what runs; bandwidth decides how fast.
Budget = RAM minus OS, runtime and KV cache. Linux boards keep about half; Macs about 80% (the 75% default is raisable via iogpu.wired_limit_mb).
Dashed cell outlines mean the model fits but leaves almost no room — those are the configuration-dependent ones.
The RTX 5090 column is the point: 1,792 GB/s buys the fastest decode on the chart, and 32 GB shuts it out of every model larger than that.
UNO-Q bandwidth estimated from the QRB2210 interface. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next counted with its N-gram table resident; mmap'd it drops to ~70 GB.
